releaseNotes: Stopped `npm run sync:runtime` reporting red on every successful install. It runs the full audit inside the installed runtime, where eight fixtures across three files assert repository invariants — the migration port ledger under docs/, cross-manifest audit-plan parity, and the maintainer's own root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md — none of which a runtime ships. They failed on ENOENT for a reason no install could fix, and a gate that is always red is a gate people stop reading.

Gave the fixture harness a skip state with a required reason, counted and printed separately from passes: a suite reporting 185 passed when eight were never evaluated is claiming coverage it does not have.
Shared one repoRoot/repoCheckoutPresent definition instead of the three identical local copies the repo-only fixtures each carried.
